notes: A random object record with owner (marker, 0xff, other), gone/ghost flags, delay and speed doubles (including +-0) and the needs-speed byte; tick steps 0..65535; the watched unit is the id in about half the cases. 0x9d72c runs as original code; the lookup, reset, advance (logs the position it is given and moves it), hit tests, destroy, ground and cell lookups and the event dispatch are stubs with per-callee return slots.
